We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR or IR to infer carbonyls. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be previous tasks? No context. We need to determine carbonyl count. Could use IR spectra to see C=O stretch. Use ir_spectra tool. That will give peaks, we can infer number of carbonyls? Might be ambiguous. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That may show peaks. But we need count. Probably simplest: use IR to detect C=O stretch peaks around 1700 cm-1. If multiple distinct peaks maybe multiple carbonyls. But ambiguous.

Better: use carbon NMR to count signals in carbonyl region (190-220 ppm). That directly counts carbonyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Let's call tool.
